Q1 [5]
A sample of calcium carbonate, $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$, of mass $5.00\ \mathrm{g}$ is heated until it fully decomposes:
$\mathrm{CaCO_3 \rightarrow CaO + CO_2}$

(a) Calculate the number of moles of $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$ used. ($M_r = 100.1$) [2]
(b) Calculate the volume of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ produced at room temperature and pressure. [2]
(c) Calculate the mass of $\mathrm{CaO}$ left. [1]
